status_model.deferred: Reflected in the 2024.1 manifest and kept out of behavior/live support until fresh 2024.1 evidence exists.

status_model.live-tested: Fresh 2024.1 read-only live sandbox evidence exists; Task 8 promotes only ak.wwise.core.object.get.
status_model.sandbox-mutating-tested: Fresh 2024.1 copied-sandbox destructive evidence exists for safe mutating APIs; readback helpers remain deferred.

metadata.status_policy: Manifest reflection and source notes alone are never behavioral support; Task 8 promotes only ak.wwise.core.object.get with read-only live evidence and Task 10 promotes only safe mutating APIs with exact 2024.1 copied-sandbox destructive evidence.
